title: Default Administration | Workout & UCC Article 9 Support | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Default administration support for commercial loans: structured workout tracking and UCC Article 9 enforcement triggers documented in the operating trail.
lede: When a commercial loan defaults, timing and documentation decide recovery. We track the workout and surface UCC Article 9 enforcement triggers as servicing events — not as a lawsuit discovered after the fact.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Accounts that break covenant or payment terms move into a delinquency-to-remediation workflow, with UCC Article 9 enforcement triggers documented in the operating trail so workout counsel is engaged on time rather than late.
Note: Veteran Loan Servicing provides default administration support as a servicer. It does not provide legal representation; legal remedies are pursued by the lender's counsel.
bullets: Timely engagement of the lender's workout counsel
Operating trail retained for the file

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Enforcement triggers live in the operating trail rather than a quarterly report, and each step is documented so the default file is defensible.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Default and workout status appear in portfolio reporting, and the documented trail supports the lender's counsel and any examiner or LP review.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: Surfacing breach signals as servicing events — with a clean trail — protects the lender's remedies and shortens the path from default to action.

faqs.q: Do you provide legal representation on defaults?
faqs.a: No. Veteran Loan Servicing provides default administration support as a servicer and documents enforcement triggers; legal remedies are pursued by the lender's own counsel.

faqs.q: How does UCC Article 9 fit in?
faqs.a: Where applicable, UCC Article 9 enforcement triggers are documented in the operating trail so remediation is timely and defensible.

faqs.q: When does an account enter default administration?
faqs.a: When it breaks covenant or payment terms and moves out of ordinary collections into the remediation workflow.

ctaBody: Request a walkthrough of the delinquency-to-remediation trail for your book.
